The short & spicy version

Flavor first.
Chaos second.

We believe the best meals are a little unpredictable. Hot Mess is a fictional sauce company built for people who want more than heat: bright ingredients, bold flavor, and the kind of kick that keeps you coming back.

From a friendly tingle to a full-on table takeover, there’s a bottle for every kind of trouble.
